_about: Shell governor settings. The config store checks the files by mtime and size; the governor and the engine each reuse a snapshot for 1 s, so a change takes effect on a call within about 2 seconds, without restart. Invalid JSON keeps the last valid version and writes a warning to the audit log. enabled=false makes the governor return no decision (emergency off). Machine paths are placeholders: {home} {temp} {appdata} {localappdata} {copilotHome}. dialog.scriptLines (optional integer) limits the script lines in the approval dialog, with a note that the full script is in the review file; absent or 0 shows the full script.

judge._about: AI judge via one long-running copilot --acp process (no tools). timeoutMs and cacheSize are defaults chosen for T1; tune after the live check.

stage3._about: Stage-3 policy (user choice 'stricter'): ASK when a hard rating is >= hardThreshold, or another rating is >= softThreshold, or confidence < minConfidence; otherwise ALLOW. A rule verdict of ASK is never lowered by the AI. Relaxations (stage 2, optional; absent = strict): taskMismatchAloneAsksAt — task_mismatch asks only at this value when every other rating is 0; credentialAccessReadOnlyAllowed — credential_access = 1 as the only rating trigger is allowed for a read-only script (classes read and read-remote; intents read; no risky or dynamic-path notes) whose engine rule ids are all in READ_ONLY_RULES (lib/policy.mjs); any other rule id asks.

replay._about: tools/replay.mjs only. excludeCwds: sessions whose cwd is one of these folders or inside one are not replayed (case-insensitive). Placeholders {home} {temp} {copilotHome} are resolved by the replay tool. The --exclude-cwd option adds to this list.
